page.layout: One printed page: title page. Text in one centred block from top to bottom, with an engraving in the middle and the imprint below it.

main_text.l: Doctrinam Veritatis, quæ secundum pietatem est;
cámque contra Adversarios quoscunque, Veteres & Novos,
vel in Fundamento fidei, vel circa illud errantes, ita asserens,
vt simul Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ V. & N.T. contineat Αλληγοριαν,

page.notes: The title is set in red and black; "THEOLOGIÆ" in the second line is red, as are "DIDACTICÆ", "TIGURI," and "Systema.". The engraving shows workers building on a foundation, with the motto "QVIS QVE VIDEAT QVOMODO SUPER ÆDIFICET" on a banner; it is not transcribed as text. The Greek word in the fifth line of the middle block is a best reading of a small italic Greek word and is uncertain. The "vt" and "Doctrinam" spellings are printed as shown except for u/v correction; the banner reads "QVIS QVE" and "VIDEAT" in the engraving only.
